products.name: PIAX VERA
products.description: For light days and the start or end of a period. A slim, soft pad that stays comfortable from morning to evening.
products.howToUse: Peel the backing and press the pad onto the centre of your underwear. Fold the wings under and press. Change every 4–6 hours; wrap the used pad and put it in the bin.
products.seoDescription: Light-flow comfort for everyday days. 6 pads per box with a soft top sheet and SAP core. Delivered across India.

products.name: PIAX LUMA
products.description: For regular flow through the day. Wings hold it in place while the SAP core manages flow as you move.
products.howToUse: Peel the backing and press the pad onto the centre of your underwear. Fold the wings under and press. Change every 4–6 hours; wrap the used pad and put it in the bin.
products.seoDescription: Everyday comfort for regular flow. 12 pads per box with a soft top sheet and SAP core. Delivered across India.

products.name: PIAX NOCTE
products.tagline: Longer cover for heavy flow and nights
products.description: A longer pad for heavy flow and overnight. The wider back and leak-management design help you sleep without worrying.
products.howToUse: Peel the backing and press the pad onto the centre of your underwear. Fold the wings under and press. Change every 4–6 hours; wrap the used pad and put it in the bin.
products.seoDescription: Longer cover for heavy flow and nights. 12 pads per box with a soft top sheet and SAP core. Delivered across India.

products.name: PIAX SEREN
products.tagline: Our longest pad, for extra-heavy nights
products.description: Our longest pad, for the heaviest nights and postpartum days, with full-length cover front to back.
products.howToUse: Peel the backing and press the pad onto the centre of your underwear. Fold the wings under and press. Change every 4–6 hours; wrap the used pad and put it in the bin.
products.seoDescription: Our longest pad, for extra-heavy nights. 6 pads per box with a soft top sheet and SAP core. Delivered across India.

products.tagline: Mix sizes to match your whole cycle
products.description: Build a box of 15 pads in any mix of sizes, so every day of your cycle is covered by the right pad.
